question: Who is the author of the historical fiction ‘Legend of Suheldev: The King Who Saved India’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Amish Tripathi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Amish Tripathi** is a renowned Indian author known for his mythological and historical fiction books.
 
• The book "**Legend of Suheldev: The King Who Saved India**" was released in **2020**.
 
• The novel narrates the story of King Suheldev, who is believed to have defeated the Ghaznavid general **Ghazi Saiyyad Salar Masud** in the Battle of Bahraich (1034 CE).
 
• Amish Tripathi is also famous for his works like the **Shiva Trilogy** and **Ram Chandra Series**.
 
• The book promotes the idea of unity in diversity and highlights India's rich historical heritage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Amish Tripathi's Writing Style**

 
 
• Known for blending **mythology, history, and fiction** in his storytelling.
 
• His books often explore themes of **courage, honor, and cultural identity**.
 
• He uses extensive research and creative imagination to depict historical and mythological events.
 
 
 
• **King Suheldev**
 
 
• King Suheldev is a semi-legendary figure in Indian history, remembered for his valor and resistance against foreign invaders.
 
• He is considered a symbol of Hindu resistance and unity during the medieval era.
 
 
 
• **About the Book "Legend of Suheldev"**
 
 
• The book is set in 11th century India, a period marked by foreign invasions and internal strife.
 
• It emphasizes the importance of **unity among Indians** to fight against external threats.
 
• Published under the banner of **Westland Publications**.
 
 
 
• **Other Works by Amish Tripathi**
 
 
• **The Immortals of Meluha** - The first book in the Shiva Trilogy.
 
• **Sita: Warrior of Mithila** - A part of the Ram Chandra Series.
 
• **Raavan: Enemy of Aryavarta** - Explores the life of Raavan from the Ramayana.
